title: mut.manual
mutation_directive: EXPAND the onion-shell structure to 5 distinct concentric shells. Each shell must be clearly visible: HIGH OPACITY particles (0.7-0.9 alpha), bright colors, large point sizes. Color palette: innermost shell deep sapphire rgb(0.04,0.1,0.6), shell 2 azure rgb(0.1,0.3,0.9), shell 3 aurora green rgb(0.1,0.7,0.4) — this is the brightest most vivid layer, shell 4 pale blue-silver rgb(0.5,0.7,0.9), outermost pale silver-white rgb(0.8,0.85,0.9). Each shell rotates at a different angular speed. Point sizes large (4-8px). Background pure black #000000. Use additive blending so shells glow and overlap create visible interference patterns.
